digest.component_or_area: CLI reference generation and distribution validation
propositions: CLI reference documentation and distribution contracts must derive entirely from runtime parser artifacts and registry enumeration, not manual command census or regex parsing
Generated help syntax must match committed package-help bytes byte-for-byte, validated by gen_cli_help.py --check and gen_cli_reference.py --check
Editorial content must be structurally separated from generated syntax and validated against the route registry without overriding parser-derived authority
A clean wheel with no optional extras must render every approved help form with exact committed bytes without triggering heavy imports or side effects
All lazy handler, parser, selector references and capability-to-extra mappings must resolve and validate without command execution
Registry-derived route enumeration must replace hand-maintained policy unions in overview, help, argparse, and exit-code tests
